name: inclusivecare
description: InclusiveCare – digital platform for people with disabilities

scripts.build: npm run build -w api && npm run build -w web
scripts.test: npm run test -w api && npm run test -w web
scripts.api:types: npm run build -w api && npm run openapi:export -w api -- ../web/openapi.json && npm run api:types -w web
scripts.test:api: npm run test -w api && npm run test:e2e -w api
